docs.description: A Table row. 10 variants: type (title, top, middle, bottom, non-expandable) × state (default, selected). title is the header row; top, middle and bottom are the positions inside an expanded group; non-expandable is a flat row. Booleans show expand and showCheckBox add the RowExpand and RowSelect cells; TitleRowContent and Row Content are slots for Column Items. Hover renders at runtime as a surface/hover overlay.

rules.reason: One row of a Table, as the description says: the header row (type=title), a flat row (non-expandable), or the top, a middle or the bottom row of a group that expands. MUI's TableRow on the web, as a <div role="row"> inside a Table, whose rows are flex boxes of their cells; bespoke in Flutter, a Semantics row inside a SolarTable. Its cells are the caller's Column Items; its select cell (a RowSelect) and expand cell (a RowExpand) are its own, drawn where it is selectable and expandable. A top row that expands says so: its expand cell is a button (aria-expanded), its own box its target, as a dense row's controls are. Selection and what a group shows are the caller's.
The header row is 40 tall and a data row 44, as Figma draws each: a row's height is its type's.
The header row's corners are rounded (radius.container), the top of the table, and a data row's are square, as Figma draws each.
